byteSlice.description: Specifies the sub-string range a facet feature applies to. Start index is inclusive, end index is exclusive. Indices are zero-indexed, counting bytes of the UTF-8 encoded text. NOTE: some languages, like Javascript, use UTF-16 or Unicode codepoints for string slice indexing; in these languages, convert to byte arrays before working with facets. Byte slices can overlap.

color.description: Facet feature applying a text color to the underlying span. For the byteSlice provided it should surround the underlying text.

value.description: A CSS-compatible color value, e.g. a hex string like #1A2B3C. SECURITY: this lexicon has no way to constrain the string's actual syntax (atproto has no regex/pattern validator) - any consuming renderer MUST treat this value as untrusted user input and allowlist it (e.g. #RRGGBB/#RGB plus a fixed keyword set) before interpolating it into a style. Never pass it through raw - doing so is a CSS-injection vector.

main.description: Span-level rich-text facets not covered by at.markpub.facets.baseFormatting - underline and text color. Same index/features shape as at.markpub.facets.baseFormatting, kept as a separate lexicon rather than a fork of it.

underline.description: Facet feature for an underlined span. For the byteSlice provided it should surround the underlying text.
